method.pooling: row-weighted mean of per-fold metrics over the evaluation slices
method.interval: percentile bootstrap of the pooled row losses, resampling matches, shared resample indices across models

calibration.formula: sum over non-empty bins of (matches/N) * abs(observed - predicted); macro is the unweighted mean over Away/Draw/Home
calibration.basis: one-vs-rest per outcome on the evaluation rows
calibration.edge_rule: [lo, hi) except the final bin which is [lo, hi]
